newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Trading stagnates.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Trading stagnates.

text.p: Trading during the after-hours session was virtually non-existent even though stocks bounded higher during normal hours in reaction to an agreement to balance the U.S. budget, traders said Friday.
"It's pretty flat," said one of them. "Everyone's gone for the weekend."
The New York Stock Exchange said Friday session one had a volume of 6,400 shares, compared with 500 for the previous day, while session two had 1.2 million against 1.0 million.
